== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1643. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-992|William Glasgow]] and [[Howie-1119|Bessie Howie]].

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-992]] is assessed at 98% (proved). Margaret’s Glasgow child entry dated 16 November 1643 names Wm. Glasgow and Bessie Howie. The exact 1643 Glasgow event names the selected William and Bessie household, distinguishing this child account from the unsupported Thomas/Agnes attribution.

Confident for the recorded child and couple; sharing the date with Margaret-3050 does not establish two identical people or prove a merge.
